summary: John's 9th-great-grandfather; Huguenot refugee in New York by 1689, probably from Moëze, Saintonge.
bio: Pierre Masse was in New York with his wife Elisabet Mercereau by spring 1689. Children baptized at the French Church: Daniel, 5 May [1689] (godfather Daniel Mercereau; godmother Marie Pare, wife of Ezéchiel Grazilier); Pierre, 25 Jun 1693 (godparents Jean La Tourette and Marie Suzanne Doucinet); Jeanne, b. 22 May, bapt. 5 Jul 1696. He witnessed all three Mersereau weddings of July-Aug 1693. An Elie Masse who signed beside him in 1693 was probably a brother (speculative). D. K. Martin (2008, pp.40-44) and WikiTree Masse-21 place his origin at Moëze, Saintonge (probable); he fled with the Mersereaus. His marriage date '29 Apr 1681' is not seen in a primary source (speculative). WikiTree's 'Daniel Masse of Moëze (1616-1675)' as his father is unsourced (speculative). Several later Masse families in the NY French register (e.g. Daniel Masse & Ester Fourret, 1700s) are not shown to be related.
